visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a graphic-heavy scene. A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a fuzzy grey hat and a black top, is superimposed over a giant pair of black panties showing white discharge. She looks at the camera, smiling slightly, and begins to speak with animated hand gestures. On the table in front of her is a light blue rectangular product box. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot where the woman sits at a wooden table in a brightly lit studio. She gestures toward her midsection and talks expressively. Various yellow and white text overlays with bold outlines appear to emphasize her points about irritation and discomfort. A pink cloth rests on the table next to the blue product box. (3) A sequence of close-ups shows the product box labeled 'LACTOMEDI' and individual blue sachets. The woman holds several of these sachets, fanning them out like cards, and then proceeds to tear one open, demonstrating the packaging. (4) An extreme close-up focuses on a hand where a clear, viscous gel is being squeezed from a blue plastic applicator onto the skin. The gel is then spread smoothly across the back of the hand to show its texture. (5) The woman returns to a medium shot, holding the product box and smiling broadly. She gives a 'peace' sign and continues her enthusiastic speech. The video ends with her framing her face with her hands and tilting her head, projecting a warm and satisfied emotion.
